text: APPROVE. The extraction keeps the original gate order, early-return conditions, verdict messages and final `Passed` record fields. `JudgeAsync` is down to roughly ten cognitive-complexity points (about six `if`s, two ternaries, a lambda and an `&&` chain), well under 15. I couldn't compile it here, so the build is the one thing taken on trust; the new helpers look type-consistent, with no obvious warning sources.
